$comment: Where loopsmith looks when a node needs a sub-agent it does not have. Sources are tried in the order given. Trust thresholds exist because an auto-installed skill runs with your permissions.

response_shape.$comment: Flat JSON array. Fields observed on every entry.

sources.$comment: The find-skills skill drives this. Prefer it for single skills; prefer the marketplace index for whole plugin bundles.

trust.$comment: A skill from a trusted owner bypasses the star and install floors. Everything else must clear both, because an installed skill runs with whatever the permission grant allowed.

policy.$comment: Quarantine is the point: an auto-acquired sub-agent is a proposal, not a decision. Promotion to ~/.claude/skills/ stays a human act.
